newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS CUTS STAKE IN S.AFRICA'S SAMES.
newsitem.headline: AMS CUTS STAKE IN S.AFRICA'S SAMES.

text.p: Microchip producer Austria Mikro Systeme International AG said on Wednesday it had reduced its stake in South African Micro-Electronic Systems (SAMES) to 19 percent from 51 percent effective as of September 30, 1996.
AMS said in a statement that the shares were taken over by the South African state-owned Industrial Development Corporation (IDC).

"IDC has taken over the SAMES shares and intends to render a substantially larger contribution than to date for the restructuring measures of transforming SAMES into an internationally competitive ASIC manufacturer," AMS said.
AMS acquired SAMES in 1995. In the first nine months of 1996, SAMES turned in a loss of 39.6 million schillings.
Moreover, AMS said it had settled a legal dispute on patent infringement with Lucent Technologies of the United States. It gave no further details.
